_meta.description: Seed ReimbursementPolicy master-data records per design.md. One policy per administration; operators may add more via Settings UI. autoApproveThreshold and requiresMarkupApprovalThreshold are consumed by OR approval-workflow (ADR-022). employeeBankAccountMapping=standard resolves Person.bankAccount at notification emission per REQ-ERP-008.

policies.name: Netherlands Standard
policies.description: Standard Dutch SMB expense policy. Reimbursable claims at or below €500 auto-approve; pass-through markup has no extra approver gate. Suitable for single-administrator administrations with moderate pass-through volume.
policies.notes: Defaults to single active policy for adm-consultancy-nl on fresh install. Bookkeeper may adjust thresholds per administration.

policies.name: Netherlands High-Touch
policies.description: Stricter Dutch SMB expense policy for complex multi-customer pass-through claims. Reimbursable claims at or below €100 auto-approve (tighter than POL-NL-01); pass-through markup amounts ≥€100 trigger an extra approver gate per REQ-ERP-006. Intended for consultancy administrations with material pass-through billing.
policies.notes: Lower auto-approve threshold + markup approval gate; consult ReimbursementPolicy.requiresMarkupApprovalThreshold semantics in spec.md REQ-ERP-006.
